entries.name: The AntiSlop
entries.description: Detects and fixes AI-sounding writing patterns. Used in audit-only mode by the agents that write prose (requirements and ADRs), through the use-antislop wrapper.
notes: Its own install.sh is broken (it copies a SKILL.md that does not exist at the repository root), so this recipe copies skills/antislop/ instead.
Upstream defaults to an editor mode that edits files directly; the use-antislop wrapper restricts it to the text the agent itself produces.
Its final section contains curl | python3 commands that refresh patterns from Wikipedia; the wrapper forbids running them.
Many lexical patterns are English-specific; structural patterns apply in any language.

entries.name: CodeGraph
entries.description: Local graph of symbols, calls and imports. Agents with Bash query it with the codegraph CLI instead of grepping and reading files one by one, through the use-codegraph wrapper.
notes: Several unrelated projects are called codegraph; this is colbymchenry/codegraph (npm @colbymchenry/codegraph).
Anonymous usage telemetry is ON by default upstream. The optional step 'telemetry-off' disables it; DO_NOT_TRACK=1 or CODEGRAPH_TELEMETRY=0 also disable it.
This recipe never runs 'codegraph install', which would edit your CLAUDE.md and MCP configuration. Agents use the CLI.
'codegraph init' creates .codegraph/ (with its own .gitignore) in each repository and keeps the index in sync in the background; 'codegraph daemon' manages that process.
The npm package has a preuninstall script that removes CodeGraph's agent integrations; since 'codegraph install' is never run, there is nothing for it to remove.

The internal .codegraph/.gitignore ignores everything except itself, so git status would show .codegraph/. The 'exclude' step adds .codegraph/ to each repository's .git/info/exclude (a local, unversioned file) when it is not already there; uninstall removes that line only from the repositories where the installer added it.
uninstall_leaves: ~/.codegraph/telemetry.json (your telemetry choice) is kept on purpose, so a later reinstall keeps telemetry off. Delete ~/.codegraph/ yourself if you do not plan to reinstall.

unix.description: Install the CodeGraph CLI, pinned version
Turn off anonymous usage telemetry (on by default upstream)
Build the code index in this repository (creates .codegraph/)
Hide .codegraph/ from git status by adding it to .git/info/exclude (local, not versioned), only if it is not already there
unix.run: f="$(git -C "{repo_path}" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path info/exclude 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -z "$f" ]; then echo not-a-git-repo; elif [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qxF '.codegraph/' "$f"; then echo already-present; else mkdir -p "$(dirname "$f")" && { if [ -s "$f" ] && [ -n "$(tail -c 1 "$f")" ]; then echo >> "$f"; fi; printf '%s\n' '.codegraph/' >> "$f"; } && echo added; fi

windows.description: Install the CodeGraph CLI, pinned version
Turn off anonymous usage telemetry (on by default upstream)
Build the code index in this repository (creates .codegraph/)
Hide .codegraph/ from git status by adding it to .git/info/exclude (local, not versioned), only if it is not already there
windows.run: $f = git -C "{repo_path}" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path info/exclude 2>$null; if (-not $f) { 'not-a-git-repo' } elseif ((Test-Path $f) -and (Select-String -Path $f -Pattern '^\.codegraph/$' -Quiet)) { 'already-present' } else { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $f) | Out-Null; $c = if (Test-Path $f) { [IO.File]::ReadAllText($f) } else { '' }; $pre = if ($c.Length -gt 0 -and -not $c.EndsWith("`n")) { "`n" } else { '' }; [IO.File]::AppendAllText($f, $pre + ".codegraph/`n"); 'added' }; $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0

unix.description: Remove the code index from this repository (.codegraph/)
Remove the .codegraph/ line the installer added to .git/info/exclude
unix.run: f="$(git -C "{repo_path}" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path info/exclude 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then { grep -vxF '.codegraph/' "$f" || true; } > "$f.agent-os.tmp" && mv "$f.agent-os.tmp" "$f"; fi

windows.description: Remove the code index from this repository (.codegraph/)
Remove the .codegraph/ line the installer added to .git/info/exclude
windows.run: $f = git -C "{repo_path}" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path info/exclude 2>$null; if ($f -and (Test-Path $f)) { $lines = @([IO.File]::ReadAllLines($f) | Where-Object { $_ -ne '.codegraph/' }); [IO.File]::WriteAllText($f, $(if ($lines.Count -gt 0) { ($lines -join "`n") + "`n" } else { '' })) }; $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
